## Product-content drift and research decision

- The public homepage and the local-session discovery article correctly expose AgentSight v1.0.31, while canonical `/integrations/cursor/` still exposes v1.0.4.
- Current v1.0.31 source was re-verified before editing. Cursor support reads `~/.cursor/projects/<workspace>/agent-transcripts/`, folds sibling `subagents/*.jsonl` work into the parent, optionally opens Cursor `state.vscdb` read-only on macOS/Linux/Windows, enriches composer timing/model/workspace fields, and can roll up locally available `bubbleId` input/output token records across the parent and discovered delegated subagent IDs.
- Missing state-database or usage enrichment does not invalidate a transcript-derived session; absent local token metadata is unavailable evidence rather than a measured zero. Cursor support still does not provide live API request/response bodies.
- Semantic-overlap decision: refresh the existing `/integrations/cursor/` canonical. The discovery article remains the cross-provider discovery/index owner; the Cursor page owns the Cursor-specific workflow, evidence interpretation, delegated work, and capture limitations. No new URL is justified.
